add.name: test-driven-development
add.purpose: Strict red-green-refactor TDD discipline: write the failing test first, watch it fail, minimal code to pass, with guidance on writing good tests.
add.how_to_use: Triggers when implementing any feature or bugfix; already listed in coding_practices but the testing list has no TDD skill.
add.notes: Cross-listed from coding_practices; mattpocock tdd (1M installs) is the alternative.

add.name: cypress-author
add.purpose: Official Cypress skill to create, update and fix Cypress E2E and component tests, via a structured identify-then-author flow with subskills.
add.how_to_use: Triggers on 'write tests' in Cypress projects; sibling skills cypress-explain, cypress-docs, cypress-cloud-cli.
add.notes: Repo has only 45 stars but is the canonical vendor source; fills the Cypress gap.

add.name: flutter-add-widget-test
add.purpose: Writes Flutter widget tests with WidgetTester to verify rendering and interactions (tap, scroll, text entry).
add.how_to_use: Triggers in Flutter projects when adding component tests; sibling flutter-add-integration-test covers E2E.
add.evidence: Official Flutter team repo, 3k stars; skills.sh 35k installs

add.name: argent-test-ui-flow
add.purpose: Autonomously tests iOS/Android app UI with interact-screenshot-verify loops via argent MCP tools (login, navigation, end-to-end scenarios).
add.how_to_use: Requires the argent MCP server and a simulator/emulator.
add.notes: Mobile manual-QA style testing; list otherwise lacks mobile UI testing.
